name: Mobility Scheme
benefit: - **Monthly Salary:** Consolidated monthly salary is provided to awardees for the entire project duration.  - **Manpower Support:** Need-based manpower support is provided to assist in project implementation.  - **Research Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per annum is provided for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment.  - ***Duration:*** Total tenure will be a maximum of five (5) years for t
_eligibility_text: - Woman scientists/academicians working at permanent position in any Government Institution/R&D Lab/University and willing to resign from their permanent position or take a long leave to avail the fellowship and after completion of the tenure return back to the parent organization. - The new place should be located beyond 500 Km from present city. - Upper age limit is 50 years to apply.
